name: Launch an online store
blurb: Pick the platform, write product pages that sell, make the product shots, then set up checkout, emails and the first ads.
description: Launch or relaunch an online store from one request: platform choice, catalog and product pages, product images, checkout, payments and the launch offer, welcome and abandoned-cart emails, first paid ads and the numbers to watch, using the Skill Garden ecommerce, image-creation, email-marketing and ad-creation super skills in order. Use when asked to start a Shopify or WooCommerce store, put products online, or lift a store's conversion.
ask: Launch an online store for <products>, selling to <customers> in <countries>.
inputs: The platform you have or prefer
Product photos and brand assets you have

steps.title: Choose the platform and set it up
steps.output: The platform, theme and apps, with the reasons and the monthly cost.

steps.title: Write the product pages
steps.output: Product titles, descriptions, variants and a page layout that sells.

steps.title: Make the product images
steps.output: Product and lifestyle shots, consistent across the catalog, at the store's sizes.

steps.title: Checkout, payments and the launch offer
steps.output: Payment methods, shipping and tax settings, and the launch offer.

steps.title: Welcome and abandoned-cart emails
steps.output: Welcome, abandoned-cart and post-purchase emails with timing, set up to reach the inbox.

steps.title: The first ads
steps.output: Ads for the best sellers in three angles.

steps.title: Measure and improve
steps.output: The five numbers to watch each week and the first tests to run.
